description: This is a PHP class named DashboardController that manages user dashboard functionalities such as activity overview, rewards, subscriptions, messages, mailing, and wallet management within the Goteo platform.

classes.name: DashboardController
classes.description: Controller class handling user dashboard functionalities such as activity feed, rewards, subscriptions, messages, mailing, and wallet features.

methods.name: createSidebar
methods.description: Sets up the sidebar menu based on the current section and zone, adding relevant links and data.

methods.name: activityAction
methods.description: Displays user activity including investments, interests, and favorite projects.

methods.name: myRewardsAction
methods.description: Shows the user's rewards, investments, and wallet balance.

methods.name: mySubscriptionsAction
methods.description: Lists active Stripe subscriptions for the user.

methods.name: walletAction
methods.description: Displays wallet details and project suggestions based on interests.
